summary: ACPICA in the kernel on QEMU's pc and q35 machines: the namespace loaded with no error counted, the SCI taken and the power button's event; and the kernel without it under rach2.noacpica; the scenario is machine/acpi_scenario.c

cases.behavior: on the pc machine ACPICA loads the firmware's namespace with no error counted, takes the SCI, and the power button's press reaches it

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes its evidence, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot the test image to the debug shell and read the boot's records
press the power button with QMP's system_powerdown, wait for the event's record and end the machine with QMP's quit

assertions.checks: a whole record says acpi: acpica: N objects, 0 errors: ACPICA loaded the namespace and counted no error
a whole record says acpi: sci: line N: ACPICA's handler took the SCI's line
after QMP's system_powerdown the kernel records acpi: event: power button, the fixed event ACPICA took from the SCI

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case reads what ACPICA makes of QEMU's own tables and presses the power button through QMP; the Lenovo's acceptance checks ACPICA on its firmware

cases.behavior: on the q35 machine, whose ACPI is the ICH9's as on the Lenovo, ACPICA loads the namespace with no error counted, takes the SCI, and the power button's press reaches it

cases.behavior: with rach2.noacpica the kernel leaves ACPICA out, and poweroff at the debug shell still stops the machine through the sleep types of \_S5 that acpi.c read from the DSDT

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes its evidence, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot the test image with rach2.noacpica to the debug shell and read the boot's records
type poweroff at the debug shell and wait for the machine to end

assertions.checks: a whole record says acpi: acpica: skipped: rach2.noacpica, and none gives a count of ACPICA's objects
the machine ends with a shutdown, as QEMU reports a write of SLP_EN
a whole record says poweroff: acpi: sleep types N and N, the power-off through \_S5
